ns2:course.label: Costume History I
ns2:course.description: Surveys theatrical costume and fashion of major periods. The course emphasizes relationships between styles of art, dramaturgy, social milieu, and production design. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: BFA/MFA Majors or consent of instructor.
